label: Object boundary
definition: Valid foreground pixels removed by a 2-pixel binary erosion.

label: RGB edge
definition: Top 10% grayscale Sobel-gradient magnitude among valid foreground pixels in each frame.

label: Harris corner
definition: Top 10% positive Harris corner response among valid foreground pixels in each frame (k=0.04, Gaussian sigma=1.5).

label: Low texture
definition: Bottom 20% local grayscale standard deviation (9x9 window) among valid foreground pixels in each frame.

label: High texture
definition: Top 20% local grayscale standard deviation (9x9 window) among valid foreground pixels in each frame.

label: Thin/protrusion heuristic
definition: Valid pixels surviving 2-pixel erosion but removed by radius-4 disk binary opening; a morphology heuristic for narrow protrusions/structures, not a semantic label.

label: High GT depth gradient
definition: Top 10% GT log-depth gradient magnitude, using only pixels whose left/right/up/down depth neighbors are all valid.

label: Smooth/flat interior
definition: 2-pixel-eroded object interior that is low-texture and lies in the bottom 50% valid GT log-depth gradient magnitude.
